            out.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels']))

seq=[]

    o=objs(current_frame)

    a=o.get('c',[])
    boxA=[x for x in a if x[2]>=40]
    if i in (0,5,10,15,20,23) or (boxA and boxA[0][1]!=boxA[0][0]+3):
        print(i, 'W',w, 'boxA',boxA)
print('final', objs(current_frame))
